integrity: The proof is a direct Ext-pullback argument plus Riemann--Roch; the numerical dimension identities are independently replayed by a standard-library checker.
scientific_limitations: Proves secant containment and linear-space existence only; no downstream unirationality conclusion is asserted without rechecking the precise hypotheses of the older quintic-unirationality theorem.
title: The \((g-1)\)-secant locus lies in the Brill--Noether hypersurface
